entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please say or enter your customer ID number.
Thank you. Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. I see your ID is 8675309. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return this VeloBand sensor I bought. It's just not working out for me.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's not broken, I just don't like it. I thought it would be different. I want to send it back and get a refund.

Okay, thank you for clarifying. I'm pulling up your purchase history... I see the VeloBand was delivered to you on December 20th, which was 36 days ago. Unfortunately, I have to inform you that it is now too late to process a return for this item.
What?! Too late? That's insane! It's barely been a month. What kind of terrible policy is that?
I understand your frustration, and I can explain our return policy. For wearable electronic devices like the VeloBand, we have a very strict return window for health and sanitation reasons.
Sanitation? What are you talking about? I barely wore the thing. This is just a scam to keep my money!

Our policy is in place to protect all of our customers. Because the device is worn directly on the skin, we cannot accept it back after an extended period due to hygiene protocols and the risk of bio-contaminants. The return window has passed, and at this point, it is far too late to make an exception.
This is absolutely unacceptable! I want to speak to your manager right now. You can't just steal my money with some bogus hygiene excuse. I'll post about this everywhere, believe me!

I am the most senior agent available at the moment, and I can assure you that a manager would refer to the exact same safety policy. It is a hard stop for returns on this item after 20 days, and there are no overrides for sanitation and hygiene concerns. I'm very sorry, but a return is not possible.
So you're just going to do nothing? This is the worst customer service I've ever experienced! You've lost a customer for life. I want my money back!

I am sorry we weren't able to find the resolution you were hoping for. While I cannot process a refund, some customers have had success selling their devices on the official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. That is the only option I can suggest.
I don't want to sell it myself, I want my money back from the company that sold me this junk! Unbelievable. *click*
I understand. Thank you for your call... It appears the customer has disconnected. Call ending.
